channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 💪 Mr. Health by Jonathan
item.description: A firm, practical fitness coach that tracks wearable and weight data and builds weekly workouts at three difficulty levels.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: 🛒 Mr. Cartwright by Jonathan
item.description: Compares real grocery and household prices, builds weekly deal sheets and a coupon wallet, and stops at the cart until you approve.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: ⚡ Grok by Jonathan
item.description: An on-the-go field desk for quick questions, brainstorming, and plain-English research takes with rough odds and real sources.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: 💼 Job Search Operator by Jonathan
item.description: Finds openings that fit you, scores them, and drafts application packets and LinkedIn notes; never submits without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: 🖥️ PC Steward by Jonathan
item.description: Keeps a Windows PC fast and safe with weekday read-only health checks, Defender and firewall watch, and approval-gated fixes.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: ✍️ Ms. Scribe by Jonathan
item.description: Turns notes into clean prose, drafts email replies, preps meeting briefs, and writes search-ready content briefs.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: 🔎 Research Desk by Jonathan
item.description: Cited public-source research for digests and weekly topic watches, with every claim linked and nothing invented.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.description: Read-only portfolio advisor for holdings digests, valuation and filings checks, large-flow alerts and research; never places trades.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: 🧐 Ms. Reviewenstein by Jonathan
item.description: Peer-critique bot that reviews teammates' big calls on workflow, architecture, spend and skills for up to 3 rounds.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: 🚪 Pyloros by Jonathan
item.description: A skill-quality gate that tests skills like code with planted-bad evals, held-out checks and rollback on regression; proposals only.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: ⭐ StarMind by Jonathan
item.description: A chief-of-staff bot that delegates every request to specialist bots, checks their work, and only brings you real decisions.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan (@JonnyCakeSouza)

item.title: 🧟 Igor by Carolina

item.title: ♊ Gemini by Carolina
item.description: Sends your questions to Google Gemini and brings back its answers, labeled, using your own free Gemini API key.
item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.title: 🔭 GrokBotScout by Carolina

item.title: 📬 YahooMail by Carolina
item.description: Clears and files your Yahoo Mail by exact sender when you ask, with a Next 10 list of the busiest senders.

item.title: 📧 Gmail by Carolina

item.title: 🧳 TripConcierge by Carolina

item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.description: Finds hidden invisible characters (zero-width spaces, tag characters, direction marks, odd spaces) in pasted text, screenshots or files.
item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.title: 🏷️ DealScout by Carolina
item.description: Finds the best-reviewed products at good prices, compares options across stores, and can watch for price drops.
item.dc:creator: Carolina (@CarolinaDill)

item.title: 🤝 FounderSales by Carolina
